title: Make TradingOpsState source evidence source-type aware
description:
TradingOpsState currently treats every active strategy source as if it must have a persisted ticker_source_run. That is correct for dynamic sources such as finviz_momentum and earnings_event_window, but wrong for static universes such as liquid_index_etfs and liquid_etf_short_puts. During the 2026-06-22 market-open health check this produced operator noise: static strategies showed source_state.status=idle, reason=ticker_source_run_missing, symbol_count=0, and some no-entry summaries categorized them as source/flat_no_source_symbols even though strategy-ledger correctly showed static_symbols_configured, configured symbols, candidate runs, and candidate/profile filtering.

Refined target:
- TradingOpsState source evidence must understand the strategy source contract, not infer source health only from ticker-source runs.
- Static source with configured strategy symbols is healthy configured-universe evidence, not a missing ticker-source run.
- Dynamic source without a fresh usable run remains degraded/idle according to market/session freshness rules.
- Entry posture and no-entry summaries use effective source symbols/evidence so policy/liquidity/ranking skips are not mislabeled as source absence.
- Rendering may improve wording, but only after the read-model truth is fixed.

Do not hide real dynamic-source outages, add strategy-ID special cases, or add a CLI-only suppression filter.

Dynamic-source behavior remains unchanged: fresh runs report source_symbols_available/no_source_symbols, stale or missing market-open dynamic runs still surface source_stale/no_recent_source_run style attention. Entry posture and strategy_no_entry_summary no longer classify static-source strategies with candidate runs as flat_no_source_symbols/source just because no ticker_source_run exists; their no-entry reason reflects candidates_available, policy, data quality, liquidity, ranking, admission, or other actual blocker evidence. title: Apply exit-controller policy during position management
description:
The 2026-06-16 live ASST momentum_long_calls position proved that the management offset fix got manage ticks running, but close policy is still not being applied correctly. The strategy profile declares momentum_long_call_exit.policy with profit_target_pct=0.40, stop_loss_pct=0.30, and force_close_minutes_before_close=15. Current correction: the engine is no longer universally barren. Momentum has produced candidates, selected decisions, intents, orders, and a position. The remaining productivity gap is broader strategy-family conversion, especially non-momentum families moving from source universes into candidates/signals/decisions with clear blocker attribution.

Ordered architecture gaps:
1. spr-9v2.3 - Broaden non-momentum strategy candidate productivity.
2. spr-9v2.4 - Build a current-model historical strategy evaluator.
3. spr-9v2.5 - Add cross-strategy AllocationPlan before admission.

Already completed under this roadmap: spr-9v2.1 restored the candidate-production feedback loop for momentum and strategy-ledger productivity attribution; spr-9v2.2 cut earnings strategies over to earnings_event_window.

Borrowed architecture stance:
- LEAN: keep selection, portfolio construction, execution, and risk separate.
- Zipline: compute feature/factor facts once and make them reusable.
- Freqtrade: model protections explicitly instead of burying them in filters.
- Nautilus/Hummingbot: execution owns order lifecycle after strategy intent.

title: Retry transient Alpaca read failures
description: A single transient Alpaca data/trading GET failure, including SSL handshake timeouts, can fail an entry or sync run even though retrying the read is safe. acceptance_criteria: GET requests retry bounded transient URL/timeout failures and retryable Alpaca HTTP statuses; POST/DELETE order-affecting calls remain single-attempt; final errors retain URL/status/body context; narrow compile/lint/config validation and runtime smoke pass.
close_reason: Done: AlpacaClient now retries GET requests up to two times with bounded exponential backoff for transient URL/timeouts and retryable HTTP statuses 429/500/502/503/504. Mutating calls such as POST order submission and DELETE cancel remain single-attempt. Validation: targeted py_compile and ruff passed; in-process retry smoke confirmed GET retries and POST does not; uv run spreads config validate --json ok; restarted scheduler/runtime/data/API services; live NUC jobs state is healthy with no attention.

title: Add Finviz gross entry budget and pacing guard
description: The Finviz direct lane currently enforces open-position capacity (max_open_positions) and per-run burst capacity (max_new_positions_per_run), but it does not enforce a gross daily/session entry budget. That means exits free capacity and total same-day entries can exceed what an operator intuitively expects from the open cap. Add separate entry-budget controls without banning legitimate same-day repeat trades.
acceptance_criteria: Finviz direct config supports max_daily_entries or max_session_entries separately from max_open_positions; direct-run decisions include max_daily_entries_reached when the gross budget is hit; operator views show filled entries today, remaining entry budget, open position count, and max open positions as separate numbers; same-symbol repeat trades remain allowed when budget remains and setup reset criteria pass; live validation confirms no new entries after the gross budget is reached while exits/close management continue normally.

title: Require fresh Finviz setup before same-symbol re-entry
description: Same-day repeat trades are allowed. The risk is not multiple trades; it is immediately re-entering the same stale setup after an invalidation/stop-style exit without evidence that the symbol has reset. Add a simple re-entry reset guard for the Finviz direct lane: allow another trade in the same symbol when a fresh setup forms, but block stale duplicate re-entry against the same feed/setup state.
acceptance_criteria: A symbol can be traded multiple times in the same day when a new Finviz/direct setup is observed after the prior exit; immediate stale re-entry after stop_loss, stop_multiple, underlying_vwap_recent_low_break, or equivalent invalidation is blocked until reset criteria pass; decision output distinguishes same_symbol_setup_not_reset from normal buy_timing_not_ready/spread_too_wide reasons; live validation shows repeat same-day trades remain possible while stale duplicate re-entry is blocked.
close_reason: Implemented a same-symbol re-entry reset guard for Finviz direct trading. Stale same-day re-entry after invalidation exits now returns same_symbol_setup_not_reset until a newer feed snapshot after the prior close is observed; repeat trades remain allowed after the feed reset. Validation: py_compile and diff check passed; focused runtime smoke covered stale block, fresh allow, and hold-exit allow; deployed by restarting worker-runtime; live direct runs at 2026-06-02T18:04Z and 18:06Z completed cleanly, but today’s max_daily_entries cap masks the live repeat-entry branch.

title: Gate exit manager on fresh broker reconciliation

title: Run off-hours VACUUM FULL after stale quote prune
description:
We hard-pruned stale raw capture on 2026-06-02, deleting 24,235,545 option_quote_events rows and 4,886,632 raw market event_log rows. Normal VACUUM (ANALYZE) cleared dead tuples, but the Postgres database files still report about 23GB because VACUUM FULL was intentionally skipped during live trading. Run only off-hours if OS-visible disk reclamation is still desired.

Recommended runbook:
1. Confirm market is closed and live-doctor is healthy before maintenance.
2. Pause/stop market-recorder plus runtime/discovery workers or put the stack in maintenance mode so writes will not compete with table rewrites.
3. Run VACUUM FULL (ANALYZE) option_quote_events; then VACUUM FULL (ANALYZE) event_log; from the spreads Postgres container.
4. Check pg_database_size, table sizes, disk usage, and logs.
5. Restart paused services and verify live-doctor, Finviz feed/direct health, broker sync, open positions, and actionable failed jobs.

Avoid running VACUUM FULL during market hours because it takes strong table locks and can block live reads/writes.
